fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on hurricane risk and the need for public education and preparedness; discussion of winter horse racing prospects and pari-mutuel betting; criticism of inadequate city health inspection and unsafe food handling (notably five-cent sandwiches); debate over Mayor E. G. Sewell’s proposed convention hall/auditorium plan and its cost; complaints about high winter rentals and landlord practices; notes on local publicity appointments (J. Paul Yoder), Miami Beach hospital plans, community music leadership changes, and assorted entertainment, sports, and society items.
